summary: FFB to May 2026 was 6,245 t (5.47 t/ha), 25% below budget to date and 23% below the same period of 2025; many bunches unripe in the dry spell.
Cost of production RM408.78/t vs RM316.15/t budget, driven by General Charges at RM179.80/t after unbudgeted Head Office directors' fees.
Manuring only 57% of rounds applied to May (late Mix B, no Kieserite until June); 2025 programme was fully completed.
Sprayer shortage and low output (1.8-2.4 ha/man-day) left circle and selective spraying at 74% and 71%; harvesters 48 vs 62 recommended.
Rat damage above the 10% threshold in most fields; several PA tables contain arithmetic errors that should be corrected before relying on them.

issues.title: Harvest cost budget per tonne mis-stated
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 Section 7: budget-to-date harvest labour RM698,935 and total RM925,110 against budget crop 8,375 t give RM83.46/t and RM110.46/t, but the table shows RM63.45/t and RM90.52/t (annual column checks out: RM2,221,531 / 24,788 t = RM89.62). Actual RM91.06/t is therefore below, not above, budget, and the total production cost budget of RM316.15/t is understated (about RM336/t when recomputed).

issues.title: CPO production figure is wrong
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 crop table shows CPO actual to date 4,519.11 t from 6,245.10 t FFB, which would be a 72% OER; the stated OER is 14.47%, which gives about 904 t. CPO yield 3.96 t/ha is built on the wrong figure.

issues.title: General Charges overspend overstated
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 says General Charges were overspent by 124%. Total actual RM1,122,872.75 vs budget to date RM720,770 is a 56% overspend; the 124% matches only Management and Supervision (RM868,005.45 vs RM386,410). The overspend is driven by unbudgeted Head Office directors' fees and remuneration (+6000%).

issues.title: Yield vs budget wording wrong
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 para 8.1 says 5.47 t/ha is 25% below a budget of 7.14 t/ha; the table budget to date is 7.34 t/ha (8,375 t). 7.14 t/ha is last year's same-period yield (para 8.2, 23% below).

issues.title: Yield trend: Agro says up, PA says down
issues.detail: Agro 1/2026 (to March) reports estate yield 3.93 vs 3.60 t/ha, +9.2% on 2025, and calls production stable with slight improvement. PA 1/2026 (to May) reports 5.47 vs 7.14 t/ha, 23% below 2025 and 25% below budget, implying April-May 2026 crop fell sharply (dry weather, unripe bunches).

issues.title: Rat damage % do not match counts
issues.detail: Same damaged-palm counts give different %: PM16B 3,256 of 30,595 palms = 10.6%, shown as 13% (PA May) and 25% (Agro March); PM17C 2,105 of 25,803 = 8.2%, shown as 13% (PA) and 20% (Agro). PM15A is 3,662 (12%) in PA vs 6,408 (21%) in Agro.

issues.title: Mature upkeep per-ha inconsistent
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 upkeep table: manuring RM626,119 over 1,141.37 ha is RM548.57/ha but shown as RM459.39/ha, so total RM664.02/ha does not equal RM861,307 / 1,141.37 (RM754.63/ha). The stated 35% underspend uses per-ha figures; on amounts it is 26% (RM861,307 vs RM1,168,900).

issues.title: PR22G 2025 yield quoted three ways
issues.detail: Agro 1/2026 para 7.2 says 1.91 t/ha, Table 18 says 1.19 t/ha, and Appendix 2(c) shows 155.23 t over 192.63 ha = 0.81 t/ha.

issues.title: 2025 yield increase % wrong in text
issues.detail: Agro 1/2026 para 7.1 says yield rose 26% from 16.64 to 22.34 t/ha; the table and arithmetic give 34.3%.

issues.title: Yield appendix errors
issues.detail: Agro 1/2026 Appendix 2: PM15A hectarage shown as 118.90 ha in 2021, 2022 and 2024 (actual 214.90), giving 2024 PM15A 31.56 t/ha vs 17.46 t/ha in Table 17. In 2025, Jan-May crop of PM15A appears under PM15A (TR) 49.50 ha, giving an implausible 43.60 t/ha.

issues.title: 2024 rainfall differs between reports
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 appendix shows 2024 rainfall 2,241 mm over 115 days; Agro 1/2026 shows 2,548 mm over 120 days, with different monthly values (e.g. January 407 vs 713.8 mm). Agro 2021 rain days total 122 but months add to 133; Agro 2024 months add to 2,551.8 mm.

issues.title: Fertiliser doses differ between reports
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 programme vs Agro 1/2026 revised programme: PR21F Jan Mix B 1.75 vs 2.0 kg/palm; PR22G Oct Mix B 1.75 vs 1.50 kg/palm; PM20E2 Apr Mix B 2.00 vs 1.75 kg/palm; PM17C third Mix B round Aug (PA) vs Sep (Agro). PM20E3 is missing from the Agro appendix.

issues.title: Palm census typo
issues.detail: Agro 1/2026 Table 3 shows PR23H total palms as 15,5530 (should be 15,530 per the RB census and total 178,386) and labels PM15A as PM14A. No new census has been done; ED's 2-2025 query on the pending census remains open.

issues.title: Labour variance sign error
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 labour table: General Worker required 6, available 3, variance shown as +3 (should be -3). Total -12 is correct.

issues.title: Agro visit date typo
issues.detail: Agro 1/2026 cover says visit 22 April 2026 but para 1.1 says 22 April 2025. Table 8 shows PM17C pruning programme 1,817 ha for 181.71 ha (other fields are 3 rounds, i.e. 545.13).

actions.item: Recruit about 14 more harvesters by July (ratio 1:20 ha, target 62)
Recruit 5 more sprayers by end June and train new sprayers
Use CDA or Inter Pump for circle spraying (target 5 ha/man-day)
Stop using Ally for circle spraying
Eradicate Mucuna climbing palms at P22/G1
Eradicate Hedyotis, Asystasia and VOPs; respray missed woodies
Complete 2026 manuring programme by October
Move to semi-mechanised fertiliser application (35-40 bags/day)
Tighten supervision of fertiliser application quality in P19D
Bait remaining blocks; rat census every 3 months, bait above 10%
Raise barn owl population; clean boxes regularly
Correct under-pruned palms at P16; avoid over-pruning in young mature
Conduct palm census, especially PR23H
Selective thinning of close-planted, etiolated palms in hilly areas
Complete supplying in PR23H this year before 2027 maturity
Review harvester vs loader earnings disparity in P19-P22
Improve FFB evacuation supervision (uncollected bunches at P19)
Prepare a running-cost budget for each Hilux
Clear loose fruit at collection platforms; improve frond stacking
Correct the per-tonne budget, CPO and General Charges figures in the PA report

kb:
LADANG SIMPAI 1 - FACT PACK (Prosper Capital Holdings Sdn Bhd, Muadzam region)

SOURCES
PA Report 1/2026 (Planting Advisory): visit 15 June 2026, review period January to May 2026, visited by Mr. Boey Chee Weng (Planting Advisor). General Manager Mr. Lee Chong Yew; Senior Manager En. Mohd Safirun Bin Mohd Azba; Estate Manager En. Rosli Bin Tengku Abdul Latif.
Agronomy Report 1/2026: visit 22 April 2026 (para 1.1 misprints 2025), data mostly to March 2026, by En. Alison Janari (Junior Agronomist) and Chong Kuan Ming (Senior Agronomist). Previous agronomy visit 14 November 2025.

AREA (both reports agree)
Total 1,256.86 ha; planted 1,249.22 ha; mature 1,141.37 ha; immature 107.85 ha (PR23H); unplanted 7.64 ha (stone hill 6.00, labour quarters 1.21, ramp 0.34, pond 0.09). Mature rose from 948.74 ha to 1,141.37 ha when PR22G (G1-G4, 192.63 ha) was declared mature in 2026. Fields: PM15A 214.90 ha (A1 70.30, A2 47.71, A3 46.59, A4 50.30); PM16B 226.63 (B1 57.71, B2 55.81, B3 32.01, B4 56.21, B5 24.89); PM17C 181.71 (C1 66.84, C2 42.44, C3 72.43); PM19D 85.19 (D1 48.28, D2 36.91); PM20E 121.41 (E1 37.72, E2 40.39, E3 43.30); PR21F 118.90 (F1 36.10, F2 40.79, F3 42.01); PR22G 192.63 (G1 39.01, G2 68.11, G3 43.10, G4 42.41); PR23H 107.85 (H1 59.01, H2 48.84). Agro: 50% of area is 8-19 years, 41% 4-7 years, 9% immature, none over 20 years.

PALM STAND (Agro Table 3)
No new census; overall 143 palms/ha, 178,386 palms. SPH: PM15A 142, PM16B 135, PM17C 142, PM19D 145, PM20E 144, PM21F 148, PR22G 148, PR23H 144 (15,530 palms; table misprints 15,5530). Close planting and etiolation seen in hilly areas, especially PM16B; thinning recommended but not done. Executive Director had asked in 2-2025 why the census was still pending; still not done.

LABOUR (PA, May 2026)
Total 65 workers vs 77 required (-12). Harvesters 48 vs 48 required at 1:25 ha; PA recommends 1:20 ha, i.e. 62 harvesters, so about 14 more to recruit by July. Drivers/loaders 4 vs 5; weeders 8 vs 12; manurers 2 vs 6 (adequate by June); general workers 3 vs 6 (table shows variance +3, should be -3). Sprayers: 9 in June, 5 more expected by end June. Worker ratio 1:16 ha. Staff adequate; Mr. Sundara Raj (Assistant) transferred in from Darabif in May, Mr. Tan Heng Boon to Darabif.

CROP PRODUCTION (PA, to May 2026)
FFB 6,245.10 t vs budget to date 8,375 t (annual budget 24,788 t); same period 2025: 6,775.83 t (on 948.74 ha); 2025 annual budget 19,105 t. Yield 5.47 t/ha vs budget 7.34 t/ha (annual budget 21.72); 2025 same period 7.14 t/ha. PA text says 25% below budget of 7.14 (the 7.14 is actually last year's figure) and 23% below 2025. OER 14.47% vs budget 14.79%; KER 4.98%. PK 310.79 t. CPO shown as 4,519.11 t, which is wrong (14.47% of 6,245 t is about 904 t). Cause cited: many unripe bunches due to dry weather; good fruit sets at P21 and P22. Bunch weights May 2025 vs May 2026: 2015 13.9 to 15.6 kg; 2016 13.1 to 13.5; 2017 12.2 to 13.2; 2019 8.0 to 8.9; 2020 4.9 to 5.4; 2021 2.9 to 4.1.

YIELD (Agro)
Estate yield 16.64 t/ha in 2024 and 22.34 t/ha in 2025 (+34.3% per table; text says 26%). 2025 by field (2024 in brackets): PM15A 23.83 (17.46); PM16B 25.31 (21.91); PM17C 28.66 (22.79); PM19D 24.51 (20.00); PM20E 15.62 (8.00); PR21F 9.63 (2.04). PR22G immature harvest 2025 quoted as 1.91 (text), 1.19 (Table 18) and 0.81 t/ha (appendix: 155.23 t). Q1 2026 vs Q1 2025 (t/ha): PM15A 3.93 vs 3.07 (+28.0%); PM16B 3.92 vs 3.86 (+1.6%); PM17C 5.04 vs 5.07 (-0.6%); PM19D 2.75 vs 4.53 (-39.3%); PM20E 1.94 vs 2.85 (-31.9%); PR21F 2.99 vs 1.80 (+66.1%); PR22G 1.29 vs 0.10; average 3.93 vs 3.60 (+9.2%). Agronomist: no major agronomic issue at PM19D/PM20E, low bunch numbers likely seasonal. Note the Agro Q1 gain had turned into a 23% shortfall by May per PA. 2025 field tonnages (appendix): PM15A(TR) 2,158.14 t, PM15A 2,963.67, PM16B 5,734.93, PM17C 5,207.33, PM19D 2,088.35, PM20E 1,896.65, PR21F 1,144.98, PR22G 155.23. 2024: PM15A 3,752.14, PM16B 4,964.66, PM17C 4,142.05, PM19D 1,705.09, PM20E 981.17, PR21F 242.23.

COST OF PRODUCTION (PA, to May 2026, RM per tonne FFB)
Total 408.78 actual vs 316.15 budget to date (annual 272.57). General charges 179.80 vs 86.06; upkeep and cultivation 137.92 vs 139.57; harvest and collection 91.06 vs 90.52 (but budget to date recomputes to 110.46, so total budget is about 336). Per tonne CPO: 1,276.17 actual. Cause: extreme over-expenditure on General Charges.

GENERAL CHARGES (PA)
Actual RM1,122,872.75 vs budget to date RM720,770 (annual RM1,729,801); RM899.57/ha vs RM577.44/ha. Management and supervision RM868,005.45 vs RM386,410; labour and amenities RM151,783.38 vs RM185,670; other RM103,083.92 vs RM148,690. PA states overspend 124% (true for M&S; overall is 56%). Reasons: staff medical +9%; Head Office/agency fees +6000% due to unbudgeted directors' fees and remuneration charged by Head Office.

MATURE UPKEEP (PA, to May 2026)
Total RM861,307 vs RM1,168,900 budget to date (annual RM2,805,249); stated RM664.02/ha vs RM1,024.12/ha; PA says 35% underspent. Weeding RM91,916 (80.53/ha vs 102.46); manuring RM626,119 (stated 459.39/ha, recomputes to 548.57, vs 770.99); pest and disease RM27,149 (22.37 vs 28.07); census nil (budget 0.39); drains RM29,167 (25.55 vs 25.41); bridges RM9,030 (7.91 vs 9.68); roads RM45,568 (39.92 vs 57.92); pruning RM32,358 (28.35 vs 29.20).

WEEDING
PA (to May): circle spraying 1,338.78 ha of 1,800.94 ha programmed (74%); not achieved due to worker shortage. By field: PM15A 100%, PM16B 75%, PM17C 100%, PM19D 100%, PM20E 50%, PM21F 67%, PR22G 61%. Output 1.8 ha/man-day by CKS high volume, very low; piece rate RM17/ha, earnings RM30.68/day; glyphosate 0.39 l/ha plus Ally 0.04 kg/ha; 9 pumps/day vs 12 potential. Advised CDA or Inter Pump and no Ally in circles. Mucuna climbing palms at P22/G1. Selective spraying 1,123.48 ha of 1,574.31 ha (71%) with mist blowers at 2.4 ha/man-day; earnings RM40.80/day vs basic wage RM65.38; 6 pumps/day; sprayers effectively worked 4 hours. Hedyotis and Asystasia dominate inter-rows; VOP spots; missed woodies show lacking supervision.
Agro (to March): PM15A circle 55%, inter-row 100%; PM16B circle 100%, inter-row 64%; PM17C circle 100%, inter-row 0%; PM19D 100%/100%; PM20E 69%/100%; PM21F 100%/70%; PM22G 58%/58%; PR23H 78%/78%. Delays from limited sprayers. Debris in circles at PM15A/PM16B-1; VOPs in PM17C2 and PM16B2; over-spraying in PM17C2; Nephrolepis in inter-rows acceptable.

MANURING
Agro: 2025 programme 100% complete (Mix B 1,281.15 t, Kieserite 105.8, RP 321.2, Fujicoat 0.5, AS Kali 70.3), with Mix B round 1 delayed 2-3 months. As at March 2026: Mix B 315.65 of 334.85 t applied (94%); Compound B 23.25 t (100%); Kieserite 0 of 66.45 t (0%, late delivery). PM19D2 application slightly ahead of schedule, 26 bags/worker at 2 kg/palm, lumpy distribution, narrow banding and missed palms; stricter supervision needed. Second-half programme revised down for fertiliser price and stock.
PA (to May): 41 of 72 rounds applied (57%). Delays: late Mix B delivery, AS dose revised lower, no Kieserite for April (delivered in stages from June). Complete programme by October. Broadcast at 25 bags/man-day, RM2.50/bag, RM62.50/day; recommends semi-mechanised 35-40 bags/day. No sub-surface application in 2026.
Revised 2026 programme (Agro, kg/palm): P15A Mix B 2.25 Feb, AS 1.00 Mar, Mix B 2.25 May, RP 1.50 Jul, Mix B 2.25 Sep. P16B Mix B 2.00, Kieserite 1.00, Mix B 2.25, RP 1.50, Mix B 2.25. P17C Mix B 2.25, AS 1.00, Mix B 2.25, RP 1.50, Mix B 1.50, Mix B 1.50. P19D Mix B 2.25, AS 0.75, Mix B 2.00, RP 1.50, Mix B 1.50, Mix B 1.50. P20E Mix B 2.00 Jan, Kieserite 0.50, Mix B 2.00 (E2 1.75) Apr, RP 2.00 Jun, Mix B 1.50, Mix B 1.50. PR21F Mix B 2.0, Kie 0.50, Mix B 1.75, RP 2.00, Mix B 1.50, 1.50. PR22G Mix B 1.50, Kie 0.50, Mix B 1.50, RP 2.00, Mix B 1.50, 1.50. PR23H Compound 1.50, Kie 0.50, Compound 1.50, RP 2.00, Compound 1.50, 1.50. Mix B = 45% SOA, 40% MOP, 14% Kieserite, 1% borate. Some PA schedule doses differ (PR21F Jan 1.75; PR22G Oct 1.75).

PEST AND DISEASE
PA rat census (May): PM15A 12% (3,662 palms), PM16B 13% (3,256), PM17C 13% (2,105), PM19D 12% (1,482), PM20E 19% (3,322), PM21F 18% (3,167), PR22G 5% (1,425). Baiting: round 1 91,169 baits (51% of 178,459 palms), round 2 44,007 (25%), round 3 19,786 (11%), round 4 3,322 (2%); 3 rounds done in 15A, 16B, 17C, 19D; none yet in B1, B4, C3, 21F, 22G, 23H; 20E only round 1. Bait when damage over 10%, census every 3 months. Barn owls: 48 boxes occupied of 62 installed; PA says 48% occupancy is low.
Agro rat census (March): PM15A 21% (6,408 palms), PM16B 25% (3,256), PM17C 20% (2,105), all above 10%. Fresh damage reduced after campaign. No rat census in young mature or immature by March. Leaf-eating pests under control. RB census PR23H: H1 4% (340 palms), H2 5% (352), total 4%, below threshold.

PRUNING AND HARVESTING
PA: progressive pruning 5,706.85 ha, 100% of programme; under-pruned palms at P16 to correct. Costs RM85/ha/yr (2015), RM70 (2016, 2017, 2019, 2020), RM60 (2021, 2022). Agro: pruning complete in mature fields by March; minor over-pruning in PM15A1, PM17C3 and PM21F-1; PM22G basal pruning 67%; frond stacking poor in hilly areas.
PA harvesting (to May): cost RM568,647 (RM91.06/t) vs RM925,110 budget to date; harvest labour RM67.81/t, internal transport RM23.25/t. Rounds 12.2 vs 10 budgeted. Average interval 14 days (previous report: 19 days). Outturn 71%. One mini tractor covers 166 ha; rest by wheelbarrow. Harvest rates RM42/t (P15, P16) to RM87/t (P22); harvester earnings RM71.82-168.92/day vs basic RM65.39; loader earnings RM28.10-119.80/day; PA flags disparity in P19-P22. Uncollected bunches at P19.
Agro: Q1 intervals up to 14-20 days in P15A/P16B; PM22G 19-26 days in January. Crop quality acceptable, some long stalks and unripe bunches; clear loose fruit at platforms to avoid VOPs. Harvesting rounds Q1 at or above target.

ROADS, DRAINS, VEHICLES, CAPEX (PA)
No road grading of 4,720 chains budgeted (suspended due to high diesel price; RM19/chain) and no laterite of 400 chains (RM105/chain); roads satisfactory. Desilting 12x10x8 ft 211.31 of 350 chains at RM51; 8x6x4 ft 373.84 of 530 chains at RM46. Hilux KEH 8191 has no running-cost budget. Capex budget RM600,000 (residential RM300,000; roads/bridges/drains RM300,000), nothing spent.

IMMATURE PR23H (PA)
Upkeep to May RM73,220 vs RM141,445 budget (RM685/ha vs RM1,324); since start RM632,647 (RM5,920/ha) plus development RM613,321. Circle spraying 2 of 2 rounds (100%); selective 1 of 2 rounds (50%); fertiliser 2 of 5 rounds (Compound B late, no RP stock). 1,074 palms supplied; finish supplying this year before maturity in 2027. Basal pruning from February, scout harvesting from April. Agro: ablation and scout harvesting satisfactory; Mucuna and VOPs present.

RAINFALL
Agro annual: 2021 3,038.5 mm (122 days listed), 2022 3,353 mm (151), 2023 4,242 mm (143), 2024 2,548 mm (120), 2025 3,169.5 mm (152); Jan-Mar 2026 275.5 mm (20 days). Dry Feb-Jul 2024 may depress yield in following 1-2 years. PA appendix: 2024 2,241 mm (115 days), 2025 3,169.5 mm (152), Jan-May 2026 717 mm (39 days); January 2026 only 65 mm.

notes: Per-tonne figures for upkeep and general charges items are calc: RM amount / FFB (actual 6,245.10 t; budget-to-date 8,375 t); report prints those items in RM and RM/ha only.
Harvest items printed per tonne (67.81+23.25=91.06 ok).
Item RM amounts sum exactly to printed group totals (general 1,122,872.75; upkeep 861,307; budget 720,770 / 1,168,900); group per-tonne totals match dashboard costParts.
Annual budget total RM/t FFB 272.57 (general 69.78, upkeep 113.17, harvest 89.62) not used.
Report's own FFB-to-date 6,245.10 t is far below budget 8,375 t, inflating per-tonne general charges (179.80 vs 86.06).
